regional_sources.supports: Brook trout in Minnesota cold clean headwaters and spring-fed gravelly riffles; a light belly, squarish tail and dark body support the source silhouette.
regional_sources.fantasy_extension: Integral elastic bow fins, stored recoil and staged monster evolution are original fiction, not biological trout capabilities.
